distinct_but_not_nominated: Cross-member class-conditional decorrelation is distinct from C1 sample variance; empirical predictive deficit and a justified quality proxy are not established.

existing_contrast.matching_required: Exact same current residual architecture, native settings, BN policy, seed/split/initialization and controller; old pilot reuse not presumed.

falsifier: No improvement of declared served VALID AUC against the complete matched F control; covariance/Jensen/latent changes cannot substitute. AUC gains with served-BCE or member-quality harm are a trade-off, not quality preservation.
